rules.target: strictly lower q*d on the current exact unit; positive scenario-weighted saving
rules.target_order: descending exact weighted activity saving, scene, Stage id, target OPP
rules.partners: original resource-related pairs containing target; singleton if none
rules.partner_modes: all legal OPPs on the partner's unchanged unit; target OPP fixed
rules.trace: one maximum-finish predecessor per node; lexicographic tie; release/floor wins equality
rules.extra_order: lexicographic original-direction resource edges on all reported deadline traces
rules.ranking: exact nonthermal full-window ledger within each target/pair; never a cutoff
rules.acceptance: complete original SAFE and new.upper < incumbent.lower
rules.scope: fixed units; no global optimality or infeasibility claim

timing.clock_origin: one caller root or method entry before imports/input/initialization/reconstruction
timing.execution_stop: cooperative checkpoints, not a hard real-time process stop
timing.evidence_cutoff: one absolute monotonic deadline; no round reset
